verdict.rationale: Brex's own marketing says its business account can earn yield ("up to 3.70%†"), so it covers interest on balances. Nothing in the pack shows that this yield applies to balances held in more than one currency. The 120+ countries claim is about general banking reach, not multi-currency interest-bearing balances. Missing for 10: evidence of multi-currency balance holding, evidence that yield applies to non-USD balances, detailed rate/terms documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can earn interest on balances held in multiple currencies

citations.quote: Unlock up to 3.70%†, fast global payments, up to 30x higher credit limits, and cash back with a Brex business account.
